messages:
nina: Postmortem follow-up quick sync: recurring issue is node-level GPU saturation at night which trips autoscaler. We need owners, short timelines, and a minimal set of mitigations to prevent recurrence. Primary items: quota request, scheduler tuning, headroom alerting, and on-call rotation for validation.

omar: I'll take quota + finance. Plan: submit request for +8 A100-equiv and propose a temporary burst policy. ETA ticket submit Wed EOD. Will include cost scenarios.

kevin: I'll own scheduler tuning experiments. Proposed canary changes: pack_threshold=0.62, scale_cooldown=40s, max_batch_size=400. Run 72h, measure p99, queue depth, and cost delta.

tara: I'll own headroom alert + runbook update. Suggest rule: rolling_avg(utilization,5m) > 82% OR queued_requests_norm > 0.7 -> alert. Include automated mitigation: short burst-enable step. I'll draft playbook.

nina: ops-bot, create a weekly reminder for these owners and attach to the incident ticket once created.

ops-bot: Tasks created: CLOUD-9233 (quota request), SCHED-4278 (AB tests), RUNBOOK-81 (headroom alert). Weekly reminders scheduled. :robot_face:

omar: CLOUD-9233 created, assigned to @omar. Request notes: +8 A100-equiv, 15% temporary burst. Link: https://redwood.internal/t/CLOUD-9233. Est. cost +14% monthly if permanent.

kevin: SCHED-4278 started on canary pool at 01:45 UTC. Config snippet: ```pack_threshold:0.62
scale_cooldown:40s
max_batch_size:400``` Will post perf snapshots to SCHED-4278.

tara: RUNBOOK-81 draft posted. Mitigation steps: 1) notify ops, 2) enable burst for 10m, 3) if persists >20m escalate to infra-leads and start failover routing. Added 1-line customer blurb for comms.

nina: Add regression gate: any scheduler change must have a 24h deploy hold with automated p99 comparison against baseline. Owner: kevin.

kevin: Ack. I'll wire the regression into CI and provide dashboard links. Note: observed a spike when batch_size=512; will keep max_batch_size<=400 in tests.

omar: Finance looped in. Will include permanent vs temporary cost options in CLOUD-9233.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: CLOUD-9233 weekly in 7 days.

nina: Thanks all. We'll review progress in one week and close tickets when actions complete.
